name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and runs Nginx as a multi-site web server, creating document roots and static landing pages, configuring per-site virtual hosts, and enabling SSL for three sites. It also includes security hardening such as fail2ban, UFW, sysctl, and SSH settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and post-configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL dependencies, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub, creates its virtual environment and database, writes environment configuration, and manages its systemd service.
